# OffconAI

> OffconAI is an offline, local-first LLM app for Android and desktop. Run GGUF models with llama.cpp or LiteRT-LM, plus vision, native voice, document RAG and local tools, on hardware you own.

Canonical: https://zmxnpquryet-gif.github.io/OffconAI/
Repository: https://github.com/zmxnpquryet-gif/OffconAI

## What it is

OffconAI is a private alternative to cloud AI for on-device work. Inference runs locally with llama.cpp (GGUF) and Google LiteRT-LM. The app includes an Ollama/OpenAI-compatible local API, an MCP tool client with per-call approval, encrypted chat storage, on-device document RAG with PDF/Office OCR, and native Omni voice or local STT/TTS.
